children.name: Palestinians have greater access to economic opportunities that are inclusive, resilient, and sustainable, including decent employment and livelihoods opportunities in an empowered private sector
Enhanced enabling environment, including policy and legal frameworks, for inclusive decent
Increased public and private investments to support green and job-rich economic growth, with a focus on infrastructure and tradeable sectors
Enhanced employability of vulnerable groups, including from amongst youth, women and persons with disabilities
Improved productivity, competitiveness and sustainability of MSMEs, start-ups and social enterprises, with a focus on vulnerable groups and communities
Enhanced access to and equitable distribution of unpaid care work and care services
Palestinians, including the most vulnerable, have equal access to sustainable, inclusive, gender responsive and quality social services, social protection, and affordable utilities
Health system is strengthened to improve access to quality and equitable health and nutrition services for all Palestinians

Increased number of children, adolescents and youth including those in humanitarian situations, have access to quality education, life skills and affordable technical and vocational training as well as tertiary education and act as agents of change

Strengthened capacities of relevant institutions and service providers and enhanced community engagement for inclusive, reliable, affordable and sustainable water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services

National authorities and civil society have strengthened systems and capacities to provide Social Protection and Protection services, and the population have improved knowledge and access to Social Protection and Protection services and rights
Improved housing and energy conditions of the vulnerable people, including those affected by conflicts and humanitarian situation.
Palestinian governance institutions, processes, and mechanisms at all levels are more democratic, rights-based, inclusive, and accountable
Strengthened institutional capacities in the areas of rule of law and inclusive access to justice and security, in particular for marginalized groups
Improved mechanisms, measures and capacities for meaningful and inclusive participation and representation in decision making and democratic processes, with a focus on marginalized groups
Strengthened policies, regulatory frameworks, and capacities of institutions and actors to ensure improved transparency, accountability, effectiveness and efficiency
Human rights treaty obligations and recommendations are integrated in national laws, policies and programmes, with mechanisms for monitoring compliance established, including through civil society
More efficient, sustainable and inclusive fiscal, budgetary and planning frameworks, including for basic services and social protection
Strengthened laws, policies and measures to protect and expand civil society space, including online
Palestinians have better access to and management of natural and cultural resources, higher resilience and adaptation to climate change and more sustainable food systems
Climate resilience and environmental sustainability are integrated in gender-inclusive land tenure, spatial planning and management, including for cultural heritage, landscape and natural habitat.
Strengthened systems, policies and plans for a more sustainable management of conventional and non-conventional water resources
Inclusive green and climate-smart agri-food systems are strengthened to enhance food security and nutrition and promote sustainable and resilient livelihoods
Capacities of communities, local authorities and national government institutions in disaster preparedness and disaster risk reduction and management are strengthened
Measures introduced to promote greening of public and private investment in natural resource-intensive sectors, including capacitating relevant actors to promote sustainable practices and policies
